Play Disney Dreamlight Valley's Pixel Perfect update now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/disney-dreamlight-valley-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1064-02&utm_id=P1064-02 

A glitchy arcade machine is causing chaos! Team up with Vanellope to chase down the runaway machine and welcome Ralph to the Valley. 

Amp up the power with the Pop City Star Path! Color your Valley with vibrant street features and neon lights, complete with a bus stop and city tram for your busy new metropolis. Dress to impress with platform sneakers and sparkly makeup—the perfect outfit to inspire a new high score!
